revision_basis.rationale: The v1 lower cutoff was defined from the second-smallest anatomical response and therefore produces two low-weight action states, while the generic action-transition clause incorrectly required at least three transitions for both cutoffs. Correct the lower-cutoff rule to require two transitions and retain a three-transition minimum for the upper cutoff. No model calculation, threshold derivation, parameter, anatomy, or measurement changed; the equation text clarifies the bilateral normalization already used in code.

model.kc_state: binary rate activity x_i=1 for KCs in the current-position group, else 0
model.mbon_rate_equation: r_j = gain * sum_i(contact_count_ij ^ alpha * x_i * weight_factor) / max_s(sum_j sum_i(contact_count_ij ^ alpha * x_i))
model.bilateral_readout: sum_j r_j over the two measured MBON-m1 cells
model.state_grouping: sort 88 measured KC IDs ascending and divide into eight non-overlapping groups of eleven
model.normalization: for each alpha, divide by the maximum bilateral anatomical drive across the eight frozen groups; no response data enter the denominator
model.time_dynamics: none in the MBON units; these are continuous rate variables, not spikes

teaching_and_learning.artificial_teacher: inactive during this gate; no biological cell identity

action_interface.direction: lower bilateral MBON rate means greater action drive
action_interface.fixed_cutoff_derivation: For each alpha/gain configuration, set two non-trainable cutoffs to 0.2 times the second-smallest and sixth-smallest bilateral full-weight rate among the eight anatomy-defined states. These are calculated from pinned contact rows before running any response table.

gate.state_activation: all eight states have positive drive to at least one MBON-m1 through measured KC contact rows
gate.rate_monotonicity: rates are non-increasing for all eight states at every ordered weight factor
gate.endpoint_effect: factor 0.2 reduces each state's rate by exactly 80 percent from factor 1.0
gate.action_sets: for both cutoffs, action sets are nested as weights decrease, full weight has no action state, and factor 0.2 has two through six action states; the lower cutoff requires at least two transitions and the upper cutoff at least three
gate.deterministic_replay: two exact calculations for every state/factor/configuration produce identical rate and action records
gate.family_robustness: at least 9 of 12 configurations qualify, all four alpha values and all three gain values are represented, the largest face-adjacent component has at least 8 configurations, and at least 6 component members qualify at both adjacent anatomy-derived cutoffs

outcome_policy.pass: admit an engineering rate-model plasticity design gate; do not claim spiking dynamics
outcome_policy.fail: continue to the next listed abstraction option while preserving this result
outcome_policy.inconclusive: repair execution only; do not alter the rate equation, cutoffs, parameters, or criteria
outcome_policy.interpretation_limit: This gate validates a deterministic anatomy-weighted rate mapping only. It does not demonstrate internal learning or fly physiology.
